title: Brandon van der Kolk VALUEx BRK 2026
description:
How YouTube Became the Largest Video Platform on TV 
The Investor Center founder on a platform that now takes more TV watch time than Netflix, and how he built a value-investing channel to over 100 million views.

See the full stream of the event here: https://youtube.com/live/V3V7bqLGP9o
summary: The speaker argues that YouTube is a unique and exceptionally strong business that dominates the streaming video market with 12.7% of TV watch time, far exceeding Netflix's 8.4%. He explains that its success is driven by a network effect where unlimited user-generated content caters to every niche interest while a flywheel system connects viewers, creators, and advertisers to sustain a viable business model.
